column2: ...So this is Mr. Paul Tamatama's mansion?
That's right... Hey, why are you tagging along, Pop!?
I'm more use than you, boy! Danbei Hayami is a master of the martial arts, I'll have you know!
And... even Natsu-chan!
Well, it sounded like fun!
But I'm so glad your house was really there, Hayami-kun! Though I never expected to meet Natsu-chan, too.
No kidding! And a big scoop fell right into my lap, too!
Tell me, boy, what is this Panther Claw after?
A life-size golden Buddha. Worth billions, maybe tens of billions, who knows?
Is the golden Buddha really safe, eh?
The house is surrounded by a police squad! What's more, inside the room is the lowest, worst so-called great detective of the century, Kogoro Iboji-sensei!
Ta-daaa!
It's because HE'S here that I'm even more worried...
And in the mansion garden!\n\nKoyayashi-kun, leader of the Rotten Detectives Club, lies in wait!
And he's another headache, too...
B-b-b-b-b... I'm Koyayashi, boy detectiiive!
Kyaaa!
Hmmm...?
Didn't you hear a girl scream?
I heard it, I heard it!
Where'd the scream come from?
Where, I wonder?
Kyaaa, heeelp!
Heh heh! Come back here! Heh heh!!
A girl's being attacked!
Hey! Lemme join... I mean, stop that!
Tee-hee! Seiji-kun and Natsuko-chan lured the police away nicely. Shall we sneak in, mister?
You bet, Honey-chan!
Uhh... ehh? Wh-who's thaaat?
Um... well...
Champions of justice, of course!
Ohh... then you're on our siiide...
That's right, on your side, on your side!
Koyayashi-boy! I heard a noise, anything abnormal?
Uhh... ehh... mmm... not reeeally... it's, like...
Is there anything abnormal or not!? Tell me, Koyayashi-boy! Tell me, tell me, pleeease!?
It's abnormally normal, normally abnormal, so normal it's abnormal, abnormally abnormal-ish normal...
Koyayashi-boy, just tell me yes or no! Just that!
Yes is yes, and yes-yes is yes, but no is no, no-no is it no, is it yes, is it yes-no... Yes-yes-yes-yes-yes...
Phew...
Splendidly muddled, that was!
I-I'm... a champion of justice?
On our side, on our side!
So this is the golden Buddha. It's beautiful...
Well then, let's haul it out!\n\nGood luck, Honey-chan!
You be careful too, mister...!
Okaaay, time to get started...\n\nHoney... FLAAASH!
It's almost the time Panther Claw announced, but...
Fear not! The golden Buddha is right here, see! Eh?
Hmm? Was its face like this...?
Hm!? It's twelve o'clock!
A visitor right on the dot! Could it be Panther Claw!?
That's why amateurs are such a pain! Would a crook come in the front door and ring the buzzer? Seriously?
B-but just in case...
The crook steals the golden Buddha by some unexpected method and leaves us all going "Whoa!"... That's basic detective-story common sense!
Is that so...?
Somebody go see to our guest!
Okaaay!
Sooo, who's our guest?
Our guest was Panther Claw!
This is Panther Claw! As promised, we've come for the golden Buddha! Resist and you die!
Eeek! You didn't have to keep THAT promise!
See!? That's why I said...!!
Mm... So this is the golden Buddha...! What beauty...!!
Iboji-kun! What are you doing, catch them!
Easy for you to say, but they said we'd die! Let's not make a fuss here, shall we...
Grrrrr!!
Hohoho, well then, everyone! We'll gratefully take it!
Phew... Ahh, thank goodness! The main thing is we're all safe! Hahaha...!
...What exactly are you here for?
Isn't it obvious?\n\nTo protect your golden Buddha, of course!
Then where's the statue!?\n\nYou, you...! TAILBONE-SPLITTER CHOP!
GYAAAH!!
The golden Buddha's right here, see!
It's riiight heeere!
Ohh! This is the golden Buddha, all right!
Well done, Koyayashi-kun!
Then the golden Buddha they carried off is...!?
A fake!
You outfoxed Panther Claw! Splendid, splendid! Hahaha!
The golden Buddha is duly returned to you! We'll take our leave!
Wh-where are you going...!?
To give Panther Claw a thrashin', that's where!
That's where!
Just what I'd expect from the leader of the Rotten Detectives Club, Koyayashi-kun!
You, you...!
Eeek, I'm off! Wait for me, Koyayashi-kun!
No need to worry!
We got our hands on the golden Buddha slick as you please...
Jill-sama! We'll soon arrive at Mirage Castle!
...Panther Claw's secret base!?
...?\n\nHmmm...
...Must be my imagination.
Mission accomplished!
Panther Claw would never dream the golden Buddha Honey-chan turned into has a transmitter on it.
Oh, mister, you're wonderful!\n\nBut where's Honey hiding the transmitter? Honey said she ends up naked when she turns into the golden Buddha...
